enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +9: Passive: +9 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Radiance +73: Passive: +73 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Radiance Lore +11: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 11% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +5 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Magical Efficiency 5%: You take a 5% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
